answers.a: The Manila International Research Conference 2026 (MIRC 2026) is a hybrid international academic conference that brings together researchers, academicians, practitioners, policymakers and students from diverse disciplines. Its theme is “The role of Artificial Intelligence, sustainability and innovation in building resilient, inclusive and future‑ready communities,” and it will be held on 29–30 September 2026 at the Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Maynila (PLM) in Intramuros, Manila.

The Manila International Research Conference 2026 runs from 27 to 30 September 2026.  

- 27 September 2026: Hospitality & Tourism sub‑conference at De La Salle – College of Saint Benilde (DLSU‑CSB).  
- 29 – 30 September 2026 (Tuesday‑Wednesday): Main conference at Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Maynila (PLM).
The venue is Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Maynila (PLM), located at Gen. Luna Cor. Muralla Streets, Intramuros, Manila, Philippines 1002.
